reason: the platform documents that a subagent cannot be granted zero tools, and that custom subagents always receive the CLAUDE.md hierarchy

evidence.finding: Every selectable agent type carries repository read access; claude, general-purpose, Explore, Plan and claude-code-guide additionally carry WebFetch and WebSearch. No selectable type can be launched without tools.
evidence.attempted_fix_result: Registered after a skills reload, but the agent registry reports it as 'Tools: All tools' -- an empty `tools: []` list is treated as unset, not as an empty tool set.
unverified: none remaining -- both previously unverified items are now settled, and both failed

isolation_probe.method: asked the registered agent to self-report its tools, its context, and any project identifiers, without calling tools
leaked_categories: repository name and absolute working-directory path
git branch, working-tree status, and the five most recent commit subjects
the user's persistent memory index, including prior-version project direction and metrics
the user's name and email address
operating system, shell, and session scratchpad path
isolation_probe.decisive_leak: One of the injected commit subjects names the incumbent forward direction. The skill requires the incumbent to be withheld from the outside agents, and the harness supplies it before the brief is read.
isolation_probe.tool_availability: unresolved by the probe; the agent declined to call anything, but its environment prose references Bash, Read and Write, and the registry reports all tools

evidence.not_fixable_by: Agent-definition frontmatter. The contamination arrives through the harness's own context injection (project instructions, environment block, git summary, user memory), which a subagent definition cannot suppress.

vendor_documentation.zero_tools: Cannot grant zero tools: There is no way to explicitly grant a subagent NO tools at all through frontmatter configuration.
vendor_documentation.empty_tools_behaviour: An empty tools list, or one resolving to zero tools, makes Claude Code refuse to launch the subagent rather than launch it tool-less.
vendor_documentation.claude_md: A non-fork subagent receives every level of the CLAUDE.md hierarchy the main conversation loads. Only the built-in Explore and Plan agents skip it, and no frontmatter field controls that.
vendor_documentation.git_status: Git status is injected from a snapshot taken at parent-session start, and can be suppressed session-wide by the includeGitInstructions setting.
vendor_documentation.agreement_with_probe: The documentation and the isolation probe agree on every point tested.

note: No outside inquiry was run. No brief was issued, no round prompts were sent, and no direction was produced. Simulating three views inside one repository-aware context was declined because the skill forbids it and because that context is saturated with the project's vocabulary, which is the exact contamination the gate exists to prevent.
unblock_requires: an agent context that receives no project-instruction, environment, git, or memory injection; or
running the three inquiries on a system with no knowledge of this repository and carrying only the brief and the replies back by hand; or
an explicit decision by the maintainer to change what the gate requires

partially_enforceable_if_the_gate_were_r.no repository reads: yes in practice -- disallowedTools covering Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, PowerShell, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit, ToolSearch, Skill
partially_enforceable_if_the_gate_were_r.no git status leak: yes -- set includeGitInstructions to false, which also removes the commit subject naming the incumbent
partially_enforceable_if_the_gate_were_r.no project instructions or memory: not for a custom agent -- the CLAUDE.md hierarchy always loads, and this project's memory index arrives through it

correction: An earlier note in this file implied the block might lift once the agent definition was registered. That was wrong. The block is a property of the platform, not of the definition, and no session restart or frontmatter change can lift it.
